title: CORE-Seg: Reasoning-Driven Segmentation for Complex Lesions via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.05911v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Medical image segmentation is undergoing a paradigm shift from conventional visual pattern matching to cognitive reasoning analysis. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise in integrating linguistic and visual knowledge, significant gaps remain: existing general MLLMs possess broad common sense but lack the specialized visual reasoning required for complex lesions, whereas traditional segmentation models excel at pixel-level segmentation but lack logical interpretability. In this paper, we introduce ComLesion-14K, the first diverse Chain-of-Thought (CoT) benchmark for reasoning-driven complex lesion segmentation. To accomplish this task, we propose CORE-Seg, an end-to-end framework integrating reasoning with segmentation through a Semantic-Guided Prompt Adapter. We design a progressive training strategy from SFT to GRPO, equipped with an adaptive dual-granularity reward mechanism to mitigate reward

translated_title: CORE-Seg：基于强化学习的复杂病灶推理驱动分割
translated_abstract: 医学图像分割正在经历从传统视觉模式匹配到认知推理分析的范式转变。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在融合语言与视觉知识方面已展现出前景，但仍存在显著差距：现有的通用多模态大模型具备广泛的常识，却缺乏复杂病灶所需的专门视觉推理能力；而传统分割模型擅长像素级分割，却缺乏逻辑可解释性。在本文中，我们提出了ComLesion-14K，这是首个面向推理驱动复杂病灶分割的多样化思维链基准数据集。为完成该任务，我们提出CORE-Seg，一个通过语义引导提示适配器将推理与分割相集成的端到端框架。我们设计了从SFT到GRPO的渐进式训练策略，并配备自适应双粒度奖励机制，以缓解奖励……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向推理驱动复杂病灶分割的思维链基准数据集ComLesion-14K，并构建了通过语义引导提示适配器将推理与分割相融合、采用SFT到GRPO渐进式强化学习训练的端到端框架CORE-Seg，推动医学图像分割从模式匹配向认知推理的范式转变。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ComLesion-14K, the first diverse Chain-of-Thought benchmark for reasoning-driven complex lesion segmentation, and proposes CORE-Seg, an end-to-end framework that integrates reasoning with segmentation via a Semantic-Guided Prompt Adapter and progressive reinforcement learning training from SFT to GRPO, driving a paradigm shift from visual pattern matching to cognitive reasoning in medical image segmentation.
